transcript.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to various tools. Use the tools provided to complete the task. Be concise and efficient. If you need to perform multiple steps, do them in sequence.

# Navigate Shopping Site and Reveal Dropdown Menus

Navigate to the shopping site at https://sa-shopping-aa-1.chats-lab-gui-agent.uk and use hover interactions to reveal dropdown menus or tooltips on the main navigation elements.

Your task:
1. Navigate to the shopping site
2. Hover over the main navigation menu items to reveal any dropdown menus or tooltips
3. Take a screenshot showing at least one revealed dropdown menu or tooltip
4. Save the screenshot to `/workspace/navigation_dropdown.png`

The screenshot should clearly show a dropdown menu or tooltip that appears when hovering over a navigation element.

I'll help you navigate to the shopping site and reveal dropdown menus through hover interactions. Let me start by taking a screenshot of the current state and then navigating to the site.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">navigate</parameter>
<parameter name="url">https://sa-shopping-aa-1.chats-lab-gui-agent.uk</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">screenshot</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Good! The site has loaded. Now let me identify the main navigation elements and hover over them to reveal dropdown menus. Let me start by hovering over the first navigation item.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">hover</parameter>
<parameter name="selector">nav a, .nav-item, [role="menuitem"]</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me take a more targeted approach. First, let me get a screenshot to see the navigation structure:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">screenshot</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Now let me hover over navigation elements. I'll try hovering over common navigation selectors:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">hover</parameter>
<parameter name="selector">nav li:first-child a</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me take a screenshot to see if a dropdown appeared:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">screenshot</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

<parameter name="action">hover</parameter>

</invoke>
</function_calls>
